Fact.Name: North Carolina standard deduction, single or married filing separately
Fact.Description: G.S. 105-153.5(a)(1). D-401 (2025) standard deduction chart: Single $12,750. Married filing separately $12,750 when the spouse does not claim itemized deductions. No addition for age 65 or blindness.

Fact.Name: North Carolina standard deduction, joint or qualifying surviving spouse
Fact.Description: G.S. 105-153.5(a)(1). D-401 (2025) standard deduction chart: Married filing jointly and qualifying widow(er) or surviving spouse $25,500. No addition for age 65 or blindness.

Fact.Name: North Carolina standard deduction, head of household
Fact.Description: G.S. 105-153.5(a)(1). D-401 (2025) standard deduction chart: Head of household $19,125. No addition for age 65 or blindness.

Fact.Name: North Carolina individual income tax rate
Fact.Description: G.S. 105-153.7(a) as amended by S.L. 2023-134 (HB 259 s. 42.1.(a)): "3.99% for tax years beginning after 2025." NCDOR publication NC-30: the rate for tax year 2026 is 3.99%. D-401 (2025) p. 4 rounds to the nearest dollar, dropping under 50 cents and increasing 50 through 99 cents. The 2025 D-400 line 15 sentence still prints 4.25%; the amount on the line is this 2026 rate.

Fact.Name: North Carolina residency answers
Fact.Description: Full-year resident is the supported D-400. Part-year and nonresident need Schedule PN. G.S. 105-153.4. D-401 (2025), residency status and line 13.

Fact.Name: North Carolina residency for this return
Fact.Description: Asked when the filer chose North Carolina. fullYear is the supported path. partYear and nonresident stop the return. Schedule PN is not calculated.

Fact.Name: North Carolina county of residence
Fact.Description: D-400 header: county where the filer lived on the last day of the year. The form prints the first five letters. No effect on the tax.

Fact.Name: Filer is a veteran
Fact.Description: D-400 veteran information: are you a veteran? Header only. No effect on the tax.

Fact.Name: Spouse is a veteran
Fact.Description: D-400 veteran information, asked on a joint return: is your spouse a veteran? Header only. No effect on the tax.

Fact.Name: Ask whether the spouse is a veteran
Fact.Description: The spouse circle is on a joint D-400. D-401 (2025), veteran information.

Fact.Name: North Carolina Schedule S addition or deduction
Fact.Description: Any Schedule S addition or deduction, including Social Security, Bailey or other retirement, interest on U.S. obligations, and bonus depreciation. D-400 lines 7 and 9. Not calculated. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: Claims the North Carolina child deduction
Fact.Description: D-400 line 10. The child deduction is not calculated. Yes stops the return. A person in the household stops separately.

Fact.Name: Claims North Carolina itemized deductions
Fact.Description: D-400 line 11 itemized circle and Schedule A. Not calculated. Yes stops the return. The supported path is the North Carolina standard deduction.

Fact.Name: Claims a Form D-400TC credit
Fact.Description: D-400 line 16. Form D-400TC is not calculated. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: North Carolina consumer use tax is due
Fact.Description: D-400 line 18. The use-tax worksheet is not calculated. Yes stops the return. No fills the circle that certifies no consumer use tax is due, and line 18 is zero. D-401 (2025), line 18. G.S. 105-164.6.

Fact.Name: North Carolina estimated, extension, partnership, or S corporation payments
Fact.Description: D-400 lines 21a through 21d: estimated tax, paid with extension, partnership, and S corporation. Not calculated. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 6 federal adjusted gross income
Fact.Description: D-400 line 6. Federal /agi. W-2 wages with no adjustments equal the W-2 box 1 total.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 7 Schedule S additions
Fact.Description: Zero. A yes to /ncHasScheduleS stops the return. Social Security, retirement, U.S. obligation interest, and other non-W-2 income stop at /flowKnockoutNcOtherFederalIncome.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 8
Fact.Description: Line 6 plus line 7.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 9 Schedule S deductions
Fact.Description: Zero. A yes to /ncHasScheduleS stops the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 10a qualifying children
Fact.Description: Zero. Dependents and a claimed child deduction stop the return. D-400 line 10a.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 10b child deduction
Fact.Description: Zero. The child deduction is not calculated.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 11 North Carolina standard deduction
Fact.Description: G.S. 105-153.5(a)(1). Single or married filing separately $12,750, head of household $19,125, married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse $25,500. Married filing separately is zero when the spouse itemizes, which is the case this tool can see of someone who is not eligible for the federal standard deduction (IRC 63(c)(6); D-401 (2025) chart). That return stops and is not filed. No addition for age 65 or blindness, and no reduction because the filer can be claimed as a dependent. North Carolina itemized deductions stop the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 12a
Fact.Description: Line 9 plus line 10b plus line 11.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 12b
Fact.Description: Line 8 minus line 12a, not below zero. A negative result is not filed: line 14 is that non-negative amount for a full-year resident, and line 15 is zero when line 14 is zero.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 14 North Carolina taxable income
Fact.Description: Full-year residents enter line 12b. Line 12b is already not below zero, so this is max(0, line 12b). Schedule PN line 13 is not calculated.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 15 after the cent-then-dollar round
Fact.Description: Round(line 14 times 3.99%). Dollar times Rational scales to cents half-even before Round half-up, so a product whose exact fraction is just under half a dollar can become 50 cents and then round up a dollar.

Fact.Name: One hundred times the exact D-400 line 15
Fact.Description: Line 14 times 399/100. That is 100 times line 14 times 0.0399, and for a whole-dollar line 14 it is exact to the cent. G.S. 105-153.7(a).

Fact.Name: D-400 line 15 North Carolina income tax
Fact.Description: Line 14 times 3.99 percent, rounded once. Under 50 cents drops; 50 through 99 cents rounds up. If zero or less, the result is zero. G.S. 105-153.7(a). D-401 (2025) p. 4. 42,250 times 0.0399 is 1,685.775, which rounds to 1,686. 29,500 times 0.0399 is 1,177.05, which rounds to 1,177. 40,213 times 0.0399 is 1,604.4987, which stays 1,604. The cent-then-dollar path produces 1,605. 45,000 times 0.0399 is 1,795.50, which rounds to 1,796. The cent-then-dollar result is one dollar high when it exceeds this exact product by more than 50 cents.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 16 tax credits
Fact.Description: Form D-400TC. Zero. A yes to /ncHasD400TcCredit stops the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 17 tax after credits
Fact.Description: Line 15 minus line 16, not below zero.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 18 consumer use tax
Fact.Description: Zero, and the certify-none circle is filled when /ncHasUseTax is no. A yes stops the return. The worksheet is not calculated. D-401 (2025), line 18.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 19
Fact.Description: Line 17 plus line 18.

Fact.Name: This W-2's North Carolina withholding for the primary filer
Fact.Description: Box 17 when the form belongs to the primary filer; otherwise zero. D-400 line 20a.

Fact.Name: This W-2's North Carolina withholding for the spouse
Fact.Description: Box 17 when the return is joint and the form belongs to the spouse; otherwise zero. D-401 (2025), lines 20a and 20b: the spouse's withholding is line 20b only on a joint return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 20a North Carolina tax withheld
Fact.Description: Primary filer's W-2 box 17. A W-2 whose box 15 is not North Carolina, or any box 20 locality, stops the return. North Carolina has no local income tax.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 20b spouse's North Carolina tax withheld
Fact.Description: Spouse's W-2 box 17 on a joint return; otherwise zero.

Fact.Name: D-400 North Carolina income tax withheld
Fact.Description: Line 20a plus line 20b.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 21a estimated tax
Fact.Description: Zero. A yes to /ncHasOtherPayments stops the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 21b paid with extension
Fact.Description: Zero. A yes to /ncHasOtherPayments stops the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 21c partnership
Fact.Description: Zero. A yes to /ncHasOtherPayments stops the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 21d S corporation
Fact.Description: Zero. A yes to /ncHasOtherPayments stops the return.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 22 additional payments on an amended return
Fact.Description: Zero. Amended returns are not this path. D-401 (2025), line 22.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 23 total payments
Fact.Description: Lines 20a through 22.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 24 previous refunds
Fact.Description: Zero. Amended returns only. D-401 (2025), line 24.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 25 net payments
Fact.Description: Line 23 minus line 24, not below zero. Line 24 is zero on this path, so this is line 23.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 26a tax due
Fact.Description: Line 19 minus line 25 when line 25 is less; otherwise zero. D-401 (2025), line 26a.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 26b penalties
Fact.Description: Zero. Penalties are not calculated.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 26c interest
Fact.Description: Zero. Interest is not calculated.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 26d penalties and interest
Fact.Description: Line 26b plus line 26c.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 26e underpayment interest
Fact.Description: Form D-422. Zero. Estimated payments stop the return, and this interest is not calculated.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 27 amount due
Fact.Description: Line 26a plus line 26d plus line 26e. D-401 (2025), line 27.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 28 overpayment
Fact.Description: Line 25 minus line 19 when line 25 is greater; otherwise zero. Line 26e is zero on this path. D-401 (2025), line 28.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 29 applied to next year's estimate
Fact.Description: Zero. Applying an overpayment to estimated tax is not this path.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 30 Nongame and Endangered Wildlife Fund
Fact.Description: Zero. Contributions are not this path.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 31 Education Endowment Fund
Fact.Description: Zero. Contributions are not this path.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 32 Breast and Cervical Cancer Control Program
Fact.Description: Zero. Contributions are not this path.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 33
Fact.Description: Lines 29 through 32.

Fact.Name: D-400 line 34 refund
Fact.Description: Line 28 minus line 33, not below zero. Contributions and the estimated-tax application are zero, so this is the overpayment. D-401 (2025), line 34.

Fact.Name: Federal income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Interest, tax-exempt interest, dividends, unemployment, Social Security, pensions, IRA and 1099-R, capital gain or a sale, Schedule C, Schedule E, 1099-MISC, or any other amount in federal total income besides W-2 wages. Schedule S items in that income, including Social Security, retirement, U.S. obligation interest, and bonus depreciation, are not calculated. Adjustments that reduce AGI are not this stop.

Fact.Name: Dependents or a North Carolina child deduction
Fact.Description: Anyone in the household, or a yes to /ncClaimsChildDeduction. D-400 line 10 is not calculated.

Fact.Name: W-2 box 15 not answered
Fact.Description: Box 15 has to be North Carolina (same state as the residence) before line 20 is printed.

Fact.Name: W-2 box 20 has a locality
Fact.Description: Box 20 is not blank. North Carolina has no local income tax, so a locality is out of scope.

Fact.Name: A W-2 box 15 is not North Carolina, or box 20 has a locality
Fact.Description: differentState is not North Carolina. An unanswered box 15 also stops a North Carolina return. Any box 20 locality stops it.

Fact.Name: North Carolina residency is part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: Incomplete until /ncResidencyStatus is answered. Schedule PN is not calculated.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: North Carolina part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: Schedule PN is not calculated. G.S. 105-153.4. D-401 (2025), line 13. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return. Incomplete until /ncResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: North Carolina Schedule S
Fact.Description: Any Schedule S addition or deduction, including Social Security, Bailey or other retirement, interest on U.S. obligations, and bonus depreciation. Lines 7 and 9. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: federal income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Non-W-2 income already stopped for a computed state return, including the Schedule S items Social Security, retirement, U.S. obligation interest, and bonus depreciation. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return. Incomplete while a sale question is unanswered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: dependents or the North Carolina child deduction
Fact.Description: D-400 line 10 is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: North Carolina itemized deductions
Fact.Description: D-400 Schedule A is not calculated. The supported line 11 is the standard deduction. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Form D-400TC
Fact.Description: Line 16 credits are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: North Carolina consumer use tax
Fact.Description: Line 18 would be a positive amount. The supported entry is zero, with the certify-none circle filled. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return. G.S. 105-164.6.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: North Carolina estimated, extension, partnership, or S corporation payments
Fact.Description: Lines 21a through 21d are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: W-2 box 15 is not North Carolina, or box 20 has a locality
Fact.Description: Any box 15 other than North Carolina, a box 15 that was not answered, or any box 20 locality. North Carolina has no local income tax. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: married filing separately and the spouse itemizes
Fact.Description: G.S. 105-153.5(a)(1) and the D-401 (2025) chart: the North Carolina standard deduction is zero when a married filing separately filer's spouse itemizes, because that filer is not eligible for the federal standard deduction. This return is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a North Carolina return, and when the filer is not in that case.
